svg.aria-label: Two roads into the game. On CPUs the census reads a trial of the brain's dials on 55 seeds, reads on, holds it out on 400 new seeds, puts it through 9 families, 22 gauntlets and 168 tests, and onto the line and main. On CUDA a population evolves a segment of 100 generations, is weighed on crucible's gauntlet against the bar, is elected a milestone, filmed on 12 tests, read by the census as the Gladiator and shipped as a net file.
